entities.name: Mobility from NR failure handling
entities.description: Procedure executed by UE when mobility from NR to another RAT fails, involving connection re-establishment and potential RLF reporting.

entities.name: MobilityFromNRCommand message
entities.description: RRC message that triggers mobility from NR to another radio access technology.

entities.name: targetRAT-Type
entities.description: Information element in MobilityFromNRCommand indicating the target radio access technology.

entities.name: voiceFallbackIndication
entities.description: Optional information element in MobilityFromNRCommand indicating voice fallback scenario.

entities.name: Connection re-establishment procedure
entities.description: RRC procedure to re-establish connection after failure, specified in clause 5.3.7.

entities.name: Actions upon going to RRC_IDLE
entities.description: Procedure executed when UE transitions to RRC_IDLE state with release cause 'RRC connection failure'.

entities.name: VarRLF-Report
entities.description: Variable storing radio link failure report information for inter-RAT mobility robustness optimization.

entities.name: Source PCell configuration
entities.description: Original configuration used in the source primary cell before mobility attempt.

entities.name: Connection establishment failure to target RAT
entities.description: Condition where UE fails to establish connection to target radio access technology.

entities.name: Unable to comply with configuration
entities.description: Condition where UE cannot comply with configuration in MobilityFromNRCommand.

entities.name: Protocol error in inter-RAT information
entities.description: Condition where protocol error in inter-RAT information causes procedure failure.

entities.name: targetRAT-Type set to eutra with MRO support
entities.description: Condition where target RAT is E-UTRA and UE supports Radio Link Failure Report for Inter-RAT MRO EUTRA.

entities.name: voiceFallbackIndication included
entities.description: Condition where voiceFallbackIndication is present in MobilityFromNRCommand.

entities.name: Suitable E-UTRA cell selected
entities.description: Condition where UE successfully selects a suitable E-UTRA cell.

relations.description: Procedure is triggered when UE fails to establish connection to target RAT.
Procedure is triggered when UE cannot comply with MobilityFromNRCommand configuration.
Procedure is triggered when protocol error in inter-RAT information causes failure.
MobilityFromNRCommand message contains targetRAT-Type information element.
MobilityFromNRCommand message may contain voiceFallbackIndication information element.
When target is E-UTRA with MRO support, UE stores handover failure information in VarRLF-Report.
When voiceFallbackIndication is included, UE attempts to select E-UTRA cell.
When suitable E-UTRA cell is selected, UE performs actions to go to RRC_IDLE.
UE reverts back to source PCell configuration during failure handling.
UE initiates connection re-establishment procedure as part of mobility failure handling.
